note: Second real bug, found while deploying eks-security-dashboard (independent of the NO_PERMISSIONS bug). Same underlying account-quota issue already found and fixed once in the sibling aws-remediation-orchestrator repo this session.
error: Error: setting Lambda Function (eks-security-dashboard-patch-check) concurrency: operation error Lambda: PutFunctionConcurrency, ... InvalidParameterValueException: Specified ReservedConcurrentExecutions for function decreases account's UnreservedConcurrentExecution below its minimum value of [10].
root_cause: Every Lambda-collector dashboard in this repo hardcodes reserved_concurrent_executions = 1 (Terraform) / ReservedConcurrentExecutions: 1 (CloudFormation). Reserving even 1 unit of concurrency fails outright in an account whose total Lambda concurrency limit equals AWS's required minimum unreserved amount (10) - true of any freshly created AWS account, not just this test account.

fix.terraform: Added enable_lambda_reserved_concurrency (bool, default true) to each dashboard's variables.tf (and collector/variables.tf); reserved_concurrent_executions = var.enable_lambda_reserved_concurrency ? 1 : null
fix.cloudformation: Added EnableLambdaReservedConcurrency parameter (String, "true"/"false", default "true") and a ReserveLambdaConcurrency condition; ReservedConcurrentExecutions: !If [ReserveLambdaConcurrency, 1, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

verified: eks-security-dashboard redeployed with enable_lambda_reserved_concurrency=false: apply succeeded, the patch_check Lambda was invoked directly and returned StatusCode 200 with a well-formed response, and all 6 of its CloudWatch metrics were confirmed published. The other 5 dashboards received the identical fix but were not independently redeployed to confirm - see docs/PROOF.md section 3.
